appearance_facts.fact: Title text reads 'Risk Index of Hazard H in US States'.
Choropleth US map; each state is a filled polygon with a 2-letter label inside.
ME polygon is filled with a very pale yellow/cream color (high end of the scale).
OK polygon is filled with a very dark maroon/burgundy color (low end of the scale).
TX polygon is filled with a dark maroon/burgundy color, similar to OK (low end of the scale).
Vertical color bar with 'High' at top and 'Low' at bottom; gradient runs pale yellow (top) through orange/red to dark maroon (bottom).
Numeric ticks 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, 0 from top to bottom.

printed_facts.fact: Tick value 100 aligned with the pale-yellow top of the bar.
Tick value 0 aligned with the dark-maroon bottom of the bar.

uncertain: No per-state numeric value is printed on the map; only the color fill encodes the index, so exact values for ME, OK, TX must be inferred from color position on the legend.
The task wording 'priority review list' is not defined on the page; it is unclear whether priority corresponds to the highest or lowest risk index value.
OK and TX appear in nearly identical dark-maroon tones, making a fine-grained distinction between their two values unreliable from color alone.
